description: This file defines the metadata for the EAPM (External Accounts/External API Management) module in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM project. It specifies the database table, fields, relationships, and indices associated with the external API configurations, such as URLs, application types, credentials, and access tokens.

methods.name: VardefManager::createVardef
methods.description: Creates vardefs for the 'EAPM' module class, setting up fields and other metadata.
